paper_id: DroidLink_ Automated Generation of Deep Links for Android Apps
title: DroidLink: Automated Generation of Deep Links for Android Apps
motivation: Apps become isolated islands; data enclosed inside cannot be accessed externally without manual refactoring
problem_framing: Automate deep link generation while resolving page dependencies and publishing requirements with minimal developer effort
key_insight: Model activity transitions as paths; compute shortest shortcuts to enable efficient deep link execution without modifying app structure
method_signature: Navigation Graph via dynamic analysis → Shortcut computation → Proxy Activity architecture for APK repackaging
evaluation_criteria: Feasibility (deep links generated) and efficiency (computation time, activity coverage)
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: Navigation Analyzer cannot reach activities requiring login; graph is incomplete. Security/privacy risks for exposing sensitive data via indexes
evidence_for_taste: quite ad-hoc and even case-by-case way
minimal refactorings to the original app
sufficiency of paths detected can be influenced
thinking_moves: 把app内页面的可达性问题建模为有向图最短路径问题
引入Proxy Activity隔离机制实现无需修改原app的deep link注入
用动态分析爬取状态机而非静态分析来发现页面状态转换
承认动态分析覆盖不全，转向讨论静态分析作为补充方案
